Name: Directory Folder Name
Description: Names the folder that gets created in the working directory on the computer which holds the saved images from running the code

Name: File Input
Description: The file path to the .h5ad file that contains the anndata oject for the dataset to be investigated

Name: Starting Timepoint
Description: Put in the number that represents the first timepoint involved in the study, or if doing a comparison study make this timepoint 0.0 and assign the control or baseline population to this timepoint.

Name: Intermediate Timepoint 1
Description: Put in the number that represents the second timepoint involved in the study.

Name: Intermediate Timepoint 2
Description: Put in the number that represents the third timepoint involved in the study.

Name: Terminal Timepoint
Description: Put in the number that represents the fourth timepoint involved in the study.

Name: Sample 1
Description: In quotes put the identifying string of characters from the sample names being used as the sample column to assign each cell to a sample variable.
Pairs samples with timepoints so that cells can be assigned times

Name: Example Matchup
Description: Pairs Sample 1 with the starting timepoint so that the cells from Sample 1 will be associated with the timepoint t0

Name: (ε) entropic regularization
Description: "determines the “spread” of cell fates, where larger values give more descendant distributions"

Name: (λ1) growth regularization of starting point
Description: "controls the strictness of ancestor-descendant couplings with larger values enforcing strict constraints"

Name: (λ2) growth regularization of terminal point
Description: "controls the strictness of ancestor-descendant couplings with larger values enforcing strict constraints"

Name: Convergence Threshold
Description: If the amount of change between the previous interation and the curent is above the threshold another iteration will proceed.If the amount of change is below the threshold then the alorithm will assume convergence and stop early.

Name: Maximum Iterations
Description: Regardless of convergence after this number of interations the algorithm will stop.

Name: Axis Color Scale
Description: Sets the tick marks on the axis of all entropy plots so that an area of the scale (9-10 for example) is able to be nuanced.

Name: Bandwidth
Description: Controls the "tightness" of boundary drawings. If the bandwidth is small, tight detailed boundaries are expected. If large, very rounded oversmoothed boundaries are expected

Name: Celltype Column
Description: Name of the metadata column containing celltype information for the cells
